The '''light concussion missile launcher''' was an antivehicle weapon used by military units on battlefields where [[Tank/Legends|tanks]], combat vehicles, and other heavy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] were often present. Unlike the standard [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]] which was mounted on starships, the light concussion missile launcher was a portable [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]]. This made it one of the most powerful personal heavy weapons to exist, however it was only effective against very large targets such as [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]], or similar vehicles. The weapon was ineffective against smaller targets such as individual soldiers.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />

The light concussion missile launcher weighed 18 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and fired a single [[light concussion missile]] before needing to be reloaded. Upon impact, the missile exploded and dealt collateral damage to any nearby targets. The light concussion missile launcher cost 4,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was available for military use only. Each light concussion missile cost 800 credits and weighed 10 kilograms.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />
